purpose: Evaluation only. Current sample admissions plus linked candidates; no bulk downloads. Public annotated, locally generated and agent-reviewed specimen evidence are reported separately.

midv-2020.labels: Template field text, MRZ and capture geometry.
midv-2020.verified: Twenty-four non-Indian passport views across eight source-document groups are admitted in public_samples.json and public_expansion_samples.json; no Indian passport layout.

midv-500.verified: Four US passport-card front views from 48_usa_passportcard.zip are admitted in public_expansion_samples.json with reviewed publisher-template mapping; all share one source-document group. No Indian passport archive.

midv-lait.labels: Template field text and frame geometry.
midv-lait.verified: Small Gujarati/Malayalam Aadhaar-layout samples retained. Synthetic script recognition does not establish all Aadhaar profile fields or valid-identifier completion.

idnet.labels: Synthetic identity metadata, original annotations, fraud variants.
idnet.verified: Eight versioned records in public_datasets.json. Five SD licence positives retained; other state layouts and state-ID routing not independently audited.

symage-w9.labels: FUNSD entities and links, token boxes/tags, field boxes.
symage-w9.verified: Six W-9 test rows 60-65 and four unrelated controls are admitted in public_expansion_samples.json. Publisher FUNSD answers and links inspected; selected W-9s contain SSNs, not EINs. Clean synthetic renders only.

jwalit-kyc.terms: No dataset licence declared in inspected card/API
jwalit-kyc.verified: Card advertises Aadhaar, PAN, passport, visa and voter ID. Independent annotation provenance, per-type counts, consent and reuse rights unresolved. Model-generated answers cannot be assumed ground truth.

indian-passport-arrow.terms: No dataset licence declared in inspected API
indian-passport-arrow.labels: Image/text descriptions advertised; exact field and MRZ fidelity unverified.
indian-passport-arrow.verified: Repository contains ind_pass.arrow. No card or licence file. Related passportDataset repo a6726f317f77091495d3e16d54dd46bc4b76c4ca also lacks licence metadata; not independent extra coverage.

unidata-indian-passports.terms: Card CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0; full data requires provider access
unidata-indian-passports.labels: Semicolon CSV passport fields and MRZ.
unidata-indian-passports.verified: Actual repository contains README and metadata/metadata_india.csv, no images. Card advertises 1000+ images but these are not the public release. Cannot run image OCR on this repository.

indian-dl-synthetic.terms: CreativeML OpenRAIL-M tag; card additionally says research/educational only
indian-dl-synthetic.labels: Generation prompt, state, format, lighting and condition; not field transcriptions.
indian-dl-synthetic.verified: 30 WebP images; publisher warns generated text may be unreadable/inaccurate. Do not treat generation prompts as OCR answers.

pan-kaggle.labels: Image and label directories visible; transcription semantics unverified.
pan-kaggle.verified: 96 files advertised; no description. Not admitted as field-accuracy truth.

aadhaar-detection.terms: Publisher page advertises CC-BY-4.0; underlying-image provenance still to review
aadhaar-detection.labels: Entity object-detection annotations, not verified text values.
aadhaar-detection.verified: Resized/augmented 416px dataset; not automatically suitable for field extraction or independent identity splits.

prado-india.labels: Reference descriptions and specimen views; no structured OCR truth.
prado-india.verified: Official Indian passport version 01001 reference, first issued 2000. Automated page retrieval returned 403. Not a modern representative test set.

commons-india.terms: Review each file licence and redactions separately
commons-india.verified: Category includes blank/censored biodata pages, covers and historical documents. Censored fields cannot measure full-record positive accuracy.

uscis-specimens.terms: Review individual official specimen reuse terms
uscis-specimens.labels: Official document references, not a paired OCR dataset.
uscis-specimens.verified: Official hub retrieval returned 403 in the source review. No paired green-card corpus admitted; a separately reviewed EAD mirror is recorded under uscis-ead-reviewed.

cbp-i94.terms: Official CBP sample; retain source and SAMPLE marking
cbp-i94.labels: Blank field labels and placeholder admission number; no completed-person truth.
cbp-i94.verified: Paper form reference. Electronic admission record coverage still needed; I-94 statistics and highway traffic datasets are unrelated.

mrv-generator.labels: Claims generated MRV-style images and expected outcomes.
mrv-generator.verified: MRV cases are unsupported-format tests in that project. Its expected routing cannot be imported as ours; not real visa coverage.

nrega-metadata.labels: Panchayat/job-card counts and geotagged works metadata.
nrega-metadata.verified: Not paired photographs and field labels of NREGA job cards.

india-pii-text.verified: Useful candidate for text extraction tests only; no matching document images. Does not establish passport, PAN, DL, EPIC or NPR image accuracy.

uscis-ead-reviewed.terms: Commons records USCIS authorship and U.S. federal government public-domain status; preserve source and specimen provenance.
uscis-ead-reviewed.labels: Ten agent visual transcriptions made before OCR inspection; no publisher field annotations or independent human double review.
uscis-ead-reviewed.verified: One completed fictional historical EAD front admitted with image/truth SHA-256 in additional_profile_samples.json. See ADDITIONAL_SOURCE_REVIEW.md; score separately from public annotated corpus.

passport.gaps: Non-Indian biodata measured. No admitted Indian biodata/back-page image-and-truth corpus.
passport.smallSamplePlan: Retain the 24 public non-Indian views and their source groups. Seek 5-10 independently reviewed Indian biodata images plus back pages across holders and editions; generated Indian contracts remain separate.

pan.gaps: Independent field truth, licence and source provenance not verified.
pan.smallSamplePlan: After admission: 5 current-layout, 5 older-layout images; number, name, relation and DOB labels; positive and invalid/partial cases.

aadhaar.gaps: LAIT covers script recognition, not representative valid front/back, masked, VID, QR or full profile accuracy.
aadhaar.smallSamplePlan: Keep current LAIT samples; add 10 reviewed front/back/masked/e-Aadhaar cases with identity grouping and explicit checksum expectations.

driving_licence.gaps: No verified Indian DL image/field corpus; diffusion metadata is not transcribed truth.
driving_licence.smallSamplePlan: 10 reviewed PVC/paper/digital examples across states; issue/NT/TR dates and vehicle classes; do not count synthetic prompts as labels.

voter_id.gaps: EPIC field labels, image provenance and reuse rights unresolved.
voter_id.smallSamplePlan: 10 reviewed old/new/e-EPIC views covering age versus DOB and relation labels.

nrega_job_card.gaps: Public administrative data is not photographed job-card OCR truth.
nrega_job_card.smallSamplePlan: 5 reviewed cards across layouts with full member rows, hierarchical identifier and location fields; partial/blank controls.

npr_letter.gaps: No verified paired National Population Register name/address letter dataset found. NPR news/audio datasets are unrelated.
npr_letter.smallSamplePlan: 5 reviewed letters with resident name, address, reference/date where present and absent-field labels; requires new collection.

us_driver_license.gaps: Only five South Dakota synthetic source documents are field-scored. Other jurisdictions, design variants, front/back and real PDF417 captures remain unmeasured.
us_driver_license.smallSamplePlan: Retain five SD cases and their difficult captures. Add small AZ/CA/other-state subsets from pinned sources after field/schema inspection, with barcode views where available.

us_state_id.gaps: Do not relabel a driver licence as a state ID. Exact non-driver images and annotations not audited.
us_state_id.smallSamplePlan: Select 5 verified non-driver cards with front/back pairing; otherwise leave a coverage gap.

passport_card.gaps: Four admitted US front views share one publisher specimen. More source identities and back-side TD1 images are needed.
passport_card.smallSamplePlan: Keep the four admitted views in public_expansion_samples.json; add a few independently labeled identities and reverse-side examples without counting more views as more holders.

us_green_card.gaps: No verified open image/field corpus; official examples need transcription and edition/back-side review.
us_green_card.smallSamplePlan: 5 permitted annotated specimen/consented cases across editions; retain specimen status and rejection expectations.

us_ead.gaps: One agent-transcribed official fictional front is admitted separately; no independently reviewed open population corpus, back side or edition coverage. I-765 applications are not I-766 cards.
us_ead.smallSamplePlan: Obtain independent transcription review for the admitted specimen, then 5-10 permitted annotated fronts/backs across editions; retain separate specimen provenance and rejection expectations.

visa.gaps: No admitted MRV-A/MRV-B image/field set. Generator outcomes may deliberately reject MRV.
visa.smallSamplePlan: 5 MRV-A plus 5 MRV-B reviewed examples, including partial MRZ; do not substitute TD3 passports.

us_i94.gaps: Official blank paper form is not positive extraction truth; no verified filled electronic/paper dataset.
us_i94.smallSamplePlan: 5 reviewed completed specimen cases covering numeric dates and D/S, plus the blank form as a negative control.

us_w9.gaps: Six admitted clean publisher-generated W-9s contain SSNs only. EIN is exercised in a separate local contract, not public image coverage; scans and handwriting remain unmeasured.
us_w9.smallSamplePlan: Keep six admitted SSN rows and optional-blank expectations. Select a few publisher-labeled EIN rows and independently reviewed capture variants before expanding field claims.

latestEvaluation.note: Active results use downloaded public datasets only. Locally generated images and agent-transcribed specimens are excluded. Missing profiles remain gaps; this tuning suite is not representative release coverage.

public.scope: Small tuning corpus with publisher annotations or renderer labels; includes synthetic source documents. Not an independent release holdout.

reviewedSpecimens.labelProvenance: Agent visual transcription before OCR; no publisher annotations or independent human double review.

syntheticContracts.scope: Simplified fictional local layouts; not real Indian or US population accuracy.

currentCoverage.note: Only public dataset samples are actively scored. Generated contracts and agent-transcribed specimens are retained as inactive engineering/research references. Repetitions and transformations do not add independent people.
